title: iberis ruderalis
intro: Iberis ruderalis, commonly known as Candytuft or Rock Candy, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic agent, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Iberis ruderalis include its analgesic, anti-bacterial, and anti-fungal properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating pain, infections, and fungal diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are also used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments.
